arxiv-2212-00427.creator: Miroslav Mitev 1 , Arsenia Chorti 1 , 2 , H. Vincent Poor 3 , Gerhard Fettweis 1 , 4
arxiv-2212-00427.description: Abstract While existing security protocols were designed with a focus on the core network, the enhancement of the security of the B5G access network becomes of critical importance. arxiv-2402-05047.title: On the log-hyperconvexity index of pseudoconvex Hölder domains in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n}
arxiv-2402-05047.creator: Tianlong Yu
arxiv-2402-05047.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tianlong Yu. Abstract : In this note we prove that every bounded pseudoconvex domain in \mathbb{C}^{n} with Hölder boundary admits a positive log-hyperconvexity index. We also get a better estimate for the plurisubharmonic exhaustion function. 1 Introduction A bounded pseudoconvex domain \Omega in \mathbb{C}^{n} is called hyperconvex if there exists 0>\phi\in PSH(\Omega) such that for every c<0 , \phi^{-1}([-\infty,c)) is relative compact in \Omega .

arxiv-2403-15807.title: Efficient Data Access Paths for Mixed Vector-Relational Search
arxiv-2403-15807.creator: Viktor Sanca, Anastasia Ailamaki
arxiv-2403-15807.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Viktor Sanca, Anastasia Ailamaki. The rapid growth of machine learning capabilities and the adoption of data processing methods using vector embeddings sparked a great interest in creating systems for vector data management. While the predominant approach of vector data management is to use specialized index structures for fast search over the entirety of the vector embeddings, once combined with other (meta)data, the search queries can also become selective on relational attributes - typical for analytical queries.

arxiv-2504-18015.title: DiffMI: Breaking Face Recognition Privacy via Diffusion-Driven Training-Free Model Inversion Thanks: Hanrui Wang (corresponding author) and Isao Echizen are with Echizen Lab, National Institute of Informatics (NII), Tokyo, Japan, e-mail: {hanrui_wang, iechizen}@nii.ac.jp. Shuo Wang is with Shanghai
arxiv-2504-18015.creator: Hanrui Wang, Shuo Wang
arxiv-2504-18015.description: Abstract Face recognition poses serious privacy risks due to its reliance on sensitive and immutable biometric data. While modern systems mitigate privacy risks by mapping facial images to embeddings (commonly regarded as privacy-preserving), model inversion attacks reveal that identity information can still be recovered, exposing critical vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2506-21853.title: Skill-Nav: Enhanced Navigation with Versatile Quadrupedal Locomotion via Waypoint Interface
arxiv-2506-21853.creator: Dewei Wang, Chenjia Bai, Chenhui Li, Jiyuan Shi, Yan Ding, Chi Zhang, Bin Zhao
arxiv-2506-21853.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dewei Wang, Chenjia Bai, Chenhui Li, Jiyuan Shi, Yan Ding, Chi Zhang, Bin Zhao. Quadrupedal robots have demonstrated exceptional locomotion capabilities through Reinforcement Learning (RL), including extreme parkour maneuvers. However, integrating locomotion skills with navigation in quadrupedal robots has not been fully investigated, which holds promise for enhancing long-distance movement capabilities. In this paper, we propose Skill-Nav, a method that incorporates quadrupedal locomotion skills into a hierarchical navigation framework using waypoints as an interface.

arxiv-2508-20401.title: Revealing Potential Biases in LLM-Based Recommender Systems in the Cold Start Setting
arxiv-2508-20401.creator: Alexandre Andre, Gauthier Roy, Eva Dyer, Kai Wang
arxiv-2508-20401.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for recommendation tasks due to their general-purpose capabilities. While LLMs perform well in rich-context settings, their behavior in cold-start scenarios, where only limited signals such as age, gender, or language are available, raises fairness concerns because they may rely on societal biases encoded during pretraining.

pmc-11445602.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a debilitating chronic disease marked by persistent inflammation and intestinal fibrosis. pmc-13388237.title: 喉返神经隧道解剖法结合系膜切除应用于甲状腺癌整块切除术174例回顾性分析
pmc-13388237.creator: 开 赵, 恒 夏, 明华 葛, 星煜 黄, 加杰 徐
pmc-13388237.description: 目的探讨喉返神经隧道解剖法结合系膜切除在甲状腺癌整块切除术中的应用价值。方法回顾性分析绍兴市中心医院2020年1月至2024年5月共174例经术前穿刺检查明确诊断为甲状腺癌的手术病例作为改良手术组，术中均采用喉返神经隧道解剖法结合系膜切除开展甲状腺癌整块切除术，其中单侧甲状腺癌手术143例，双侧甲状腺癌手术24例，峡部甲状腺癌手术7例。选取在同期相同团队进行的共178例经术前穿刺检查明确诊断为甲状腺癌且采用传统两步法进行手术的病例作为传统手术组，其中单侧甲状腺癌手术160例，双侧甲状腺癌手术18例。结果两组手术均顺利完成。与传统手术组比较，改良手术组患者术后暂时性喉返神经麻痹发生率、自体甲状旁腺移植数、中央区淋巴结清扫数、ⅣB区淋巴结清扫数，以及单侧手术患者的手术时间等指标均更优（均P<0.05）。截至2026年5月25日，患者随访时间为15~77个月，所有患者均未报告甲状腺癌复发等不良情况。结论喉返神经隧道解剖法结合系膜切除行甲状腺癌整块切除术操作方便，淋巴结清扫彻底，可以保护喉返神经及甲状旁腺，值得推广应用。 甲状腺癌是最常见的内分泌相关癌症。在过去的30多年里，甲状腺癌的发病率一直呈现上升趋势［1］。近年来，甲状腺腔镜手术发展迅速，但开放手术仍是甲状腺癌根治术的标准术式［2］。传统开放手术通常采用的是两步法，即先切除甲状腺，然后进行中央区淋巴结清扫。目前临床上甲状腺癌患者大多已按照指南要求在术前做了细针吸取细胞学检查，明确了病理诊断，不再需要行术中冰冻病理诊断来明确甲状腺肿物性质，肿瘤和周围组织整块切除更符合肿瘤根治原则，且可明显缩短手术时间，提高工作效率。传统切除手术存在一些不足：如在使用两步法清扫中央区时，可能因组织残端挛缩导致中央区清扫不彻底；传统整块切除术自下而上清扫中央区淋巴结可能会将较低位置的部分中央区淋巴结遗漏，导致清扫不彻底。 保护喉返神经在甲状腺癌根治术中十分重要，传统方法是在肉眼下识别喉返神经，即通过一些解剖标志如甲状腺下动脉交叉处、喉返神经入喉处等对喉返神经进行解剖。但这些方法存在不足，如从喉返神经入喉点开始寻找可能会导致喉返神经和（或）其分支损伤；若从甲状腺下动脉交叉处开始寻找则可能因为游离喉返神经的距离较长而损伤下甲状旁腺血供。通常外科医生会选择从甲状腺中极水平外侧开始，沿甲状腺侧韧带向上游离。但这些方法均直接暴露喉返神经，手术中解剖操作必须小心，避免喉返神经受到不必要的损伤，如牵拉伤或手术能量器械灼伤喉返神经［3］。为避免以上问题，在多年的临床实践基础上，我们采用喉返神经隧道解剖法结合系膜切除开展甲状腺癌整块切除术，取得了满意的效果。 对象与方法 研究对象 研究纳入2020年1月至2024年5月在绍兴市中心医院行开放性甲状腺癌根治术的患者共352例。其中，174例患者采用喉返神经隧道解剖法结合系膜切除开展甲状腺癌整块切除术（改良手术组），178例患者采用传统两步法手术（传统手术组）。纳入标准：①年龄18岁及以上；②术前超声引导下甲状腺细针吸取细胞学检查后明确为甲状腺癌；③术前未行任何甲状腺相关治疗，无既往颈部手术史；④术前电子喉镜检查提示声带无异常，发音、呼吸正常；⑤术前影像学检查未见明显淋巴结转移及神经、血管、周围组织侵犯；⑥患者及家属签署知情同意书；⑦相关临床资料完整。排除标准：①合并严重心、肺、肝、肾、血液等系统疾病；②术前甲状腺功能、甲状旁腺功能异常。
